name: Abū Muḥammad Makkī ibn Abī Ṭālib ibn Muḥammad ibn Mukhtār al-Qaysī
summary: Grammarian and master of the Qurʾān readings of Qayrawān and Cordoba, author of Mushkil iʿrāb al-Qurʾān and al-Tabṣira on the seven readings.
bio: Ibn al-Anbārī calls Makkī an excellent grammarian, learned in the readings, and names among his many books the Iʿrāb mushkil al-Qurʾān, al-Tabṣira on the seven readings and a book on the ways of the readings.
Born in Qayrawān, he taught in Cordoba, where he died in 437/1045.

sources.title: Ibn al-Anbārī, Nuzhat al-alibbāʾ fī ṭabaqāt al-udabāʾ (Cairo 1294/1877), pp. 421
Mekkî b. Ebû Tâlib, TDV İslâm Ansiklopedisi
